subject: Confirm your email for inform9
heading: Confirm your email
body:
Hello {{name}},

Select the button to confirm your email address and finish creating your inform9 account. The link expires {{expires_text}}.
footnote: If you did not create an inform9 account, you can ignore this message.

subject: Reset your inform9 password
heading: Reset your password
body:
Hello {{name}},

Select the button to choose a new password. The link expires {{expires_text}} and works once.
footnote: If you did not ask for a reset, ignore this message. Your password stays the same.

subject: {{business_names}} asked for your W-9
heading: {{business_names}} asked for your W-9
body:
Hello {{payee_name}},

{{business_names}} uses inform9 to collect W-9 forms. You fill in the form online and sign it on screen. It usually takes a few minutes.

inform9 shares your completed W-9 only with the business or businesses named in this message.
footnote: You received this message because {{business_names}} asked inform9 to request a W-9 from {{payee_email}}.

subject: Reminder: {{business_names}} is waiting for your W-9
heading: Your W-9 is still needed
body:
Hello {{payee_name}},

{{business_names}} is still waiting for your W-9. You can complete and sign it online in a few minutes.

subject: {{sender_name}} sent you a W-9
heading: A W-9 from {{sender_name}} is waiting
body:
{{sender_name}} sent you a W-9 through inform9.

Confirm your email address with a one-time code to view and download it. The link works until {{expires_date}}.
footnote: {{sender_name}} entered your email address. If this message reached you by mistake, use the link below to tell us.

subject: Your inform9 code is {{code}}
heading: Your one-time code
body: Enter this code to continue. It works for {{code_minutes}} minutes.
footnote: If you did not ask for a code, ignore this message.

subject: Your W-9 for {{business_names}} was received
heading: W-9 received
body:
Hello {{payee_name}},

{{business_names}} received your signed W-9. Thank you for completing it.
footnote: Questions about this form can go to {{business_names}}.

subject: {{payee_name}} completed a W-9
heading: W-9 received from {{payee_name}}
body: {{payee_name}} completed and signed a W-9 for {{business_name}}. You can view and download it in inform9.

subject: {{payee_name}} updated their W-9
heading: Updated W-9 from {{payee_name}}
body: {{payee_name}} sent an updated W-9 for {{business_name}}. The earlier version stays saved.

subject: {{payee_name}} declined your W-9 request
heading: Request declined
body: {{payee_name}} declined the W-9 request for {{business_name}}.

subject: Your W-9 request to {{payee_name}} could not be delivered
heading: Email could not be delivered
body: The request email to {{payee_email}} bounced. Check the address and send the request again.

subject: Reminders ended for {{payee_name}}
heading: Reminders have ended
body: The last reminder went to {{payee_name}} for {{business_name}}, and the W-9 is still open. You can send the request again or reach out another way.

subject: Reminders stopped for {{payee_name}}
heading: Reminders stopped
body: Reminders to {{payee_name}} for {{business_name}} have stopped because {{stop_reason}}.

subject: {{recipient_business}} downloaded your W-9
heading: Your W-9 was downloaded
body: {{recipient_business}} downloaded the W-9 you sent.
footnote: inform9 sends this notice for the first download only.

subject: Your W-9 to {{recipient_email}} was closed
heading: Your W-9 link is closed
body: {{recipient_email}} {{closed_reason}}. The link no longer works.

subject: Your W-9 to {{recipient_email}} could not be delivered
heading: Email could not be delivered
body: The email to {{recipient_email}} bounced. Check the address and send the W-9 again.

subject: Sending is paused on your inform9 account
heading: Sending is paused
body:
Hello {{name}},

We paused W-9 sending from your account while we review recent activity. We will email you when the review is done.

subject: Sending is available again
heading: Sending is available again
body:
Hello {{name}},

We finished our review. You can send W-9s from your account again.

subject: Sending is turned off on your inform9 account
heading: Sending is turned off
body:
Hello {{name}},

After a review, we turned off W-9 sending from your account. Your account and saved W-9 remain available. To ask about this decision, write to {{support_email}}.

subject: Your inform9 receipt
heading: Payment received
body:
Hello {{name}},

Thank you. Your {{plan_name}} plan is active.

subject: Your inform9 account was canceled
heading: Account canceled
body:
Hello {{name}},

Your plan has ended and reminders have stopped. You can download your W-9s until {{download_until}}. After that date, inform9 deletes your business records under our retention policy.

heading: {{heading_text}}
